tools.name: extract_ngzorro_topic
tools.description:
NgZorroAntd Intelligent Assistant Preprocessing Tool - Entry point to parse any NG-ZORRO component queries.

When to use this tool:
- **NG-ZORRO-related queries**: Questions about affix, alert, anchor, autocomplete, avatar, back-top, badge, breadcrumb, button, calendar, card, carousel, cascader, checkbox, collapse, comment, date-picker, descriptions, divider, drawer, dropdown, empty, form, grid, icon, image, input, input-number, layout, list, mentions, menu, message, modal, notification, page-header, pagination, popconfirm, popover, progress, radio, rate, result, select, skeleton, slider, space, spin, statistic, steps, switch, table, tabs, tag, time-picker, timeline, tooltip, transfer, tree, tree-select, typography, upload components.
- **UI tasks**: Forms, tables, menus, overlays, interactions.
- **Problem solving**: Errors, unexpected behavior, performance.
- **Learning & implementation**: API understanding or code examples.

Key features:
- **Smart Component Detection**: Heuristics over the user query to pick the best NG-ZORRO component.
- **Topic & Intent Extraction**: Determine key topics and user intent (learn/implement/solve).
- **Task Complexity Handling**: Decompose complex tasks into subtasks.
- **Seamless Integration**: Prepares structured data for the 'query_ngzorro_document' tool.

query.description: User specific question or requirement description

library.description: NgZorroAntd component name (optional) - If not specified, tool will try to detect from query text

maxTopics.description: Maximum number of extracted topic keywords, default 5, can be increased appropriately for complex tasks
